run_score_model: run the score function to evaluate a pre-trained MXNet model on a dataset with accuracy metrics
run_cli_evaluation: run the CLI script with --model flag to score a model checkpoint on a validation dataset
create_data_iterator: create an MXNet ImageRecordIter data iterator with custom batch size, RGB mean, and data shape
load_model_checkpoint: load an MXNet model checkpoint symbol and parameters using mx.model.load_checkpoint for inference
test_model_accuracy: test a pre-trained model's accuracy and top-5 accuracy on an image classification dataset
